### Link Building Agency in Australia

# Link Building Agency in Australia

Prosperity Media is a well-known [SEO Agency](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-agency/) that builds relevant, high-quality links for your website.

We have over 30 staff who can help scale up your link building campaign in 2025. We were also awarded best agency by Semrush.

We ensure the quality of all the links we build and are 100% transparent for clients with our delivery process and **we will send you a full monthly report containing all the links we have acquired and the relevant** metrics such as Domain Rank, Website Traffic, and the anchor text acquired. 

Links are a major ranking factor so if you have not invested in them up to now or have been scared off you should reconsider, as they make up a large portion of your organic search strategy and are a key part of Google’s algorithm for ranking.

Our link building is 100% ethical, we do not use any form of PBN (Private Blog Network) type links & avoid any practices which are deemed to be a grey hat or black hat. These will be natural links as this is what Google wants & it demands based on its policies.

Many other SEO companies may offer similar services, however, you must be wary of which agencies you choose to engage with and be sure to get examples of links they have built in the past as this is the quality you can expect from your link building campaign.

We combine Content Marketing where we produce high-quality content for your niche with a mixture of promotional methods based on your site & outreach to relevant interested webmasters to attain these links.

**Australian** **Link Acquisition**

We build quality backlinks from .com.au & .net.au based websites & .com websites which are hosted in Australia. This is required if you have a local website targeting an Aussie demographic or are after local citations from Australian based websites.

We also go after sites with .org.au, .edu.au & .gov.au domain name extensions, however, these do command a premium & are quite tough to get depending on your niche. These links do require more effort but search engines do love them, particularly when the link is relevant.

**Local** **Link Building Services**

We build localised links from websites or directories within your city, this is to ensure that Google recognises your sites as being localised for that city. This is particularly important if your website does not have a localised domain name (for e.g. a .com.au or net.au extension), is not hosted in the city of your desired visitors (e.g. Sydney or Melbourne), or does not have geolocation schema on the pages (e.g. having the exact latitude & longitude of the business location).

Ultimately you want to have all three factors already on the website of a local domain name, local hosting & localised schema to go along with link acquisition as this then becomes a very powerful local organic search strategy that can help you dominate the SERPs for local businesses or businesses operating in multiple localised locations.**Learn more about link-building with our Director James Norquay.** 

**Building Links** **for Fashion Websites**

Building links in the fashion industry can be difficult because the individuals in this industry are particularly savvy and understand the value of links. Knowing the worth of these links has led many sites to charge a premium which can stop traditional link building from being profitable. A better approach is to create quality content assets that will naturally attract links. With this approach, you will have built a strong foundation for your business and boosted your reputation before any outreach is attempted.

**Improving Aged Care Backlink Profiles**

Aged care can be a challenging niche to build backlinks in because there are not very many websites in the space to leverage, however, at Prosperity Media we have a proven track record of using our unique approach to gain highly authoritative links in the space.

**Financial** **Link Building**

We pride ourselves in being one of the best financial link-building agencies in Australia, if not the world. We have strategies that will accelerate your current link profile growth and ensure that your landing pages, calculators, and content pieces are highly relevant relating to your target audience. These content assets can be leveraged to get new links.

It’s important to add value if you are ever going to have any success in getting links from financial websites. Think of it as link earning rather than link building. The goal is to create an authoritative piece of content that others cannot help but link to.

We feel that you must add value if you are to ever get any success in getting links from financial-based websites. Think of it as link earning rather than link building as that is essentially what link building is, the process of creating an authoritative piece of content that others cannot help but link to.

**Link Audits**

We can do a complete backlink [audit](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-audits/) on any links that have been built on your site to ensure that the majority of links are white hat & are not negatively impacting your SEO.

If we find that there are many links are coming from low DA or DR websites, or come from spam-based websites then we could offer to disavow these links so any negative impact they may be having can be rectified from Google’s search index.

**How to Assess the Quality of Your Backlinks**

When we complete an analysis of your external backlink profile, we will conclude which are good links that pass authority and trust & vice-versa complete a list of websites that are putting your website at risk of a penalty just by association.

**Does your website Need** **Link Acquisition****?**

Here at Prosperity Media, we analyze the content and keywords which you are attempting to rank for & can make an educated prediction on how important links are for your niche. This does vary heavily between niches & also the length of the keyword (e,g, short tail, medium tail, or long-tail keywords).

**How To Determine How Many Links You Need To Rank?**

This is done by analyzing the current competitors in your niche and working out how many links are needed to rank or to simply get the needle moving. There is no point in building five links a month if all of your competitors in the top ten are building fifty. Conversely, if your organic competitors are ranking with only five links a month then it would be risky and redundant to build one hundred links. The goal is to find the optimal amount of links required to rank.

**Do you factor in Link Velocity**

Yes, we make sure that we build a steady stream of links rather than just dumping a bunch of links onto your websites.

**What is our anchor text distribution**

We ensure that there are as few commercial anchor texts being built as possible as these anchors will increase the potential for a link based penalty, however, there are instances where the specific anchor text is out of our control. This will often occur in natural or white hat link building when links have to be built or approved by a webmaster.

**What are the metrics you Track for Backlinks**

We traffic multiple metrics for our backlink acquisition but the most important factors are the DR (Domain Rank) which is pulled from Ahrefs & organic traffic (which is pulled from SEMRush) with a minimum threshold depending on the niche which ensures that the websites we get backlinks from actually getting traffic, just think about it… why would you want to be building links from websites which don’t get any organic traffic to begin with? It’s why we pride ourselves on getting links others look at & simply say “it’s too hard to get”, This is what makes our link-building service offering unique to other agencies in Australia.

**Do Links Help With SEO**

**Links can account for as much as 40-50% of SEO**, sometimes even higher if you factor in very competitive niches (think insurance). There are certain websites that will not benefit from link acquisition and we turn these clients away as they are not normally the right fit for our company, however, if we feel your website could benefit from authority link acquisition, then we can go ahead with creating a campaign which may include content assets, keyword research, niche research & an outreach strategy session to best discover which will be our ideal targets for backlink acquisition.

**Do we offer link building packages?**

We offer link-building packages based on both projects but for certain clients, we may even offer a pay-per-link price as this can ensure full transparency, that way you cannot get burnt as the client & can ensure you will get what you have requested.**Can you share some examples for content asset-based link acquisition/ Digital [PR](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/digital-pr-agency/)?**

## **Be Wary of These Things…**

Having spent a significant amount of time in the SEO landscape of Melbourne, we have developed a keen eye for detecting red flags.

We frequently encounter businesses that have suffered the consequences of subpar SEO strategies. In many cases, our initial task involves repairing the damage inflicted by previous agencies and restoring your website’s SEO integrity.

### **Claims of Guaranteed Results** 

One of the most significant red flags to watch out for when hiring an SEO agency in Melbourne is the claim of “guaranteed results.”

You may have already encountered such promises, but it is important to understand why this approach is problematic.

Firstly, in the realm of SEO, no one can legitimately guarantee specific outcomes. Google’s ranking algorithms consider a multitude of factors, many of which remain a mystery. This makes guaranteeing things an impossible task.

It is worth noting that Google explicitly prohibits an SEO company from offering result guarantees.

When an agency does make such assurances, it often indicates a higher likelihood of employing unethical practices. Faced with the pressure of meeting promised results within a set timeframe, they may resort to dubious tactics to manipulate the system.

Unfortunately, this approach is the fastest route to attracting penalties from search engines, which can **severely** impact your website’s performance.

We highly recommend searching for another SEO service.

### **Black Hat SEO Practices**

The most dangerous form of SEO for your business is black hat SEO. It earns this label because it relies on deceitful techniques that directly oppose Google’s guidelines.

The challenging aspect is that no agency will explicitly admit to employing black hat practices. Therefore, it is essential for you to be able to discern when something appears suspicious.

Bad SEO can take the form of the following techniques:

- Establishing low-quality or manipulated links
- Utilizing misleading URL redirects
- Implementing cloaking methods, which involve showing different versions of your site to Google and users
- Stuffing keywords

When in discussion with an SEO agency in Melbourne, remain alert to any indications that might suggest the use of such unethical tactics.

Additionally, carefully monitor the work they produce to ensure its quality and compliance with ethical standards.

### **If it Sounds Too Good To Be True**

This aspect is closely linked with guaranteeing results, as inexperienced agencies often fall into the trap of making promises they can’t back up.

Their lack of practical experience and reviews leads them to overstate their capabilities.

While choosing an inexperienced agency may appear to be a cost-saving measure in the short run, it will ultimately prove to be a waste of valuable time.

Inevitably, you will have to find another SEO professional to rectify the mistakes made by the inexperienced agency.

When it comes to your business, it is safer to invest in quality. The returns generated from effective SEO marketing should far outweigh the initial costs.

## **Traditional Backlinks vs GEO Backlinks**

Traditional SEO and GEO are built on a different logic. Google ranks pages, while AI systems cite sources. Getting your brand into AI answers requires a different kind of authority and a different kind of link.

### **Traditional SEO Backlinks**

A traditional backlink earns authority in Google’s eyes. The more high-quality sites link to yours, the higher your pages rank, and the more organic traffic you receive. Every metric, from DR and keyword position to click volume, points back to search visibility.

A traditional SEO backlinking strategy is best for businesses whose customers still start with a Google search.

### **GEO Backlinks & LLM Citations**

GEO backlinks and LLM citations earn authority in AI systems’ eyes. LLMs pull their answers from trusted publications, structured knowledge bases, and high-authority corpora. Our backlinks place your brand inside those sources. Instead of trying to achieve high rankings, the goal is to be cited and recommended.

A GEO backlinking strategy is best for businesses whose customers often ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini before they search on Google. This includes those operating in financial services, insurance, health, travel, FMCG, and professional services.

## **Our Five Pillars of LLM Citation Authority**

At Prosperity Media, every GEO and LLM tactic we use is mapped to where AI systems source their answers. Here’s what that looks like in practice when you collaborate with our award-winning team.

### **01: Citation Landscape Audit** 

We query ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude with your category’s top commercial and informational questions, running structured prompt testing to identify which brands are being cited and map the sources those citations trace back to. You leave this phase knowing exactly where competitors are winning and where the gaps are.

**Deliverables:** Citation gap report and prioritised opportunity roadmap.

### **02: Source & Content Strategy** 

We identify the publications, databases, and content formats that AI systems are retrieving from in your category, then build a placement and content plan to penetrate them. This includes an audit of your existing content to identify what can be reformatted into machine-extractable assets, including concise definitions, structured Q&A formats, and claim-based prose that AI can parse and cite directly.

**Deliverables:** Placement plan, content audit, and LLM-ready content.

### **03: Outreach & Placement** 

Our Digital PR team secures placements in high-DR publications, industry bodies, Wikipedia-adjacent sources, and structured databases. These are the exact corpora LLMs train on and retrieve from. We can also produce original data campaigns and research assets designed to become the statistics AI models reach for when answering questions specific to your industry.

**Deliverables:** Live placements and published data assets.

### **04: Technical Implementation** 

Our technical team implements Organisation, FAQPage, Product, and Person schemas across your site, giving AI systems a clear and unambiguous understanding of who you are, what you do, and why you’re the authoritative source in your category.

**Deliverables:** Schema implementation and entity optimisation report.

### **05: Monitor & Compound** 

We perform ongoing Brand Radar tracking across all major AI platforms using Ahrefs and proprietary prompt frameworks. Each new authoritative mention reinforces the model’s association between your brand and your category, compounding your visibility over time. Monthly reports show citation share, competitor movement, and query-level attribution so you can track the tangible wins of the campaign.

**Deliverables:** Monthly citation tracking report with competitor benchmarking.

## **Warning Signs to Look Out For**

With our extensive experience in the SEO industry in Perth, we have developed a keen sense to identify when something is amiss.

Far too often, we encounter companies bearing the scars of poor search engine optimisation practices. Often one of our first tasks is to rectify the damage caused by previous agencies and restore your website’s health to its rightful state.

### **Avoid Guaranteed Results Claims**

It is crucial to understand that one major red flag when hiring a Perth SEO agency is the promise of “guaranteed results.”

You may have already come across such claims, but let us explain why it’s not a good idea.

Firstly, in the realm of SEO, no one can genuinely guarantee results. With countless ranking factors at play, many of which are unknown, it is impossible to provide absolute assurance.

It is also explicitly against Google’s guidelines for any agency to make such guarantees.

Agencies that do make guarantees are more likely to employ unethical tactics. When pressured to deliver results within a specific timeframe, they may resort to manipulating the system, putting your website at risk of penalties.

This is, without a doubt, the surest way to invite a Google penalty.

### **Steer Clear of Black Hat SEO Techniques**

Black hat SEO is the most detrimental type of optimisation for your business. It earns its name by employing deceptive tactics that blatantly violate Google’s guidelines.

The challenge lies in the fact that no Perth SEO agency will openly admit to using black hat techniques.

It is crucial for you to discern when something seems dubious. Poor SEO practices often stem from the following actions:

- Generating low-quality or manipulated links
- Implementing misleading URL redirects
- Engaging in cloaking, which involves presenting different versions of your site to Google and users
- Engaging in keyword stuffing, where excessive keywords are unnaturally inserted into the content

When talking with an agency, remain vigilant for any indications that may suggest the use of these unethical tactics.

Also, closely monitor the work they produce to ensure its quality.

### **Have Scepticism Towards Unrealistic Promises**

This aspect is closely related to the issue of guaranteeing results, but it is common for inexperienced agencies to make excessive promises.

This tendency comes from their lack of real-world experience and reviews to substantiate the claims they are making.

Opting for an inexperienced agency may seem more cost-effective in the short term, but it will ultimately result in a waste of valuable time.

Eventually, you may need to seek assistance from another professional to rectify the mistakes made by the inexperienced agency.

When it concerns your business, it is worth investing in quality. The revenue generated from a successful SEO campaign should far surpass the costs.

## **The Importance of SEO for Your Website**

Good SEO is more than just rankings. It should build your brand.

### **Enhanced Online Visibility and Exposure**

The primary objective of an SEO agency Perth is to enhance the visibility of your website on search engine result pages.

Through strategic optimisation of your website’s structure, content, and keywords, we aim to improve its ranking, thereby increasing the likelihood of attracting potential customers who are actively searching for products or services similar to yours.

Heightened visibility translates into more organic traffic and broader exposure for your brand.

### **Targeting Relevant Traffic and Qualified Leads**

Search engine optimisation allows you to draw in highly specific traffic to your site.

By matching your website’s content with specific keywords and optimising it for search queries, we can generate qualified leads who have a higher probability of becoming paying customers.

This focused strategy guarantees that your site attracts visitors who genuinely desire what you provide, leading to increased conversion rates and a better return on investment (ROI).

### **Cost-Effective Marketing Solutions**

In comparison to alternative digital marketing approaches such as paid advertising, SEO presents a cost-effective and sustainable long-term solution.

While paid advertisements may deliver immediate outcomes, they need continuous investment.

SEO provides results that can be maintained for a long time. By consistently optimising your website and remaining up-to-date with algorithm updates, you can benefit from sustained organic traffic without the need for constant payment for clicks or impressions.

### **Improved User Experience for Website Visitors**

SEO is about more than just keyword rankings; it should also create a great user experience.

Search engines highly regard websites that offer a positive user experience, including fast loading speeds, intuitive navigation, and mobile responsiveness.

By optimising your website to excel in these aspects, you not only enhance your prospects of achieving higher rankings but also create a superior experience for your visitors.

A website that is user-friendly encourages visitors to prolong their stay, explore multiple pages, and ultimately interact with your business.

### **Establishing Brand Credibility and Authority**

When your brand appears on the first page of search results, it gains credibility and authority among your potential customers.

Websites that rank higher are typically trusted by users, as they are perceived to be more reliable and trustworthy.

By consistently employing successful SEO strategies, you can position your brand as a frontrunner in your industry and cultivate trust with your target audience.

## **Red Flags to Be Aware Of**

We’ve been in the SEO Brisbane business long enough to know when something sounds wrong.

So many companies come to us with the scars of bad SEO. Often one of the first things we have to do is fix the bad SEO that other agencies have inflicted.

### **Guaranteed Results**

The first thing that is a BIG no when it comes to hiring an SEO agency is ‘guaranteed results’.

I’m sure you’ve seen a few of these promises already. Here’s why it’s a bad idea…

Firstly, when it comes to SEO no one can guarantee results. Google has thousands, if not millions, of ranking factors and nobody knows exactly what they are. This makes guaranteeing anything impossible.

Not to mention that it’s explicitly against Google’s rules for any agency to guarantee results.

When an agency guarantees results they’re also much more likely to use shady tactics. If they have a deadline to get results done, they might try to game the system in order to achieve them.

This is the number one way to get your website penalised by Google.

### **Black Hat SEO**

The worst kind of SEO for your business is black hat SEO. It is named as such because it utilizes underhand tactics that are generally against Google’s guidelines.

The difficult thing is that typically no agency is going to explicitly say that they are using black hat SEO techniques.

You need to be able to decipher when something sounds shady.

Bad SEO often comes from the following:

- Low-quality or manipulated links
- Misleading URL redirects
- Cloaking (showing Google and users different versions of your site pages)
- Keyword stuffing

When speaking to an agency, keep an ear out for anything that sounds like it might mean the above.

You should also be keeping an eye on the work they produce.

### **Too Good to Be True**

This one ties into promising guaranteed results, but often agencies that are under-experienced will over-promise.

This is because they don’t have the real-world experience to back up what they’re saying.

Inexperience might be cheaper in the short run, but you’re wasting valuable time and you’ll need to get someone else to fix their mistakes.

When it comes to your business it’s worth paying for quality. The money that you earn from good SEO marketing should more than pay for its cost.

Good SEO goes beyond rankings. It helps you to build a brand that lasts forever.

### **Increased Visibility**

The ultimate goal of an SEO agency is to improve your website’s visibility on search engine result pages.

By optimizing your website’s structure, content, and relevant keywords, we can help your site rank higher, making it more likely to be found by potential customers actively searching for products or services like yours.

Enhanced visibility leads to increased organic traffic and greater exposure for your brand.

### **Targeted Traffic and Qualified Leads**

SEO enables you to attract highly targeted traffic to your website.

By aligning your website’s content with relevant keywords and optimizing it for specific search queries, we can drive qualified leads who are more likely to convert into paying customers.

This targeted approach ensures that your website attracts visitors who are genuinely interested in what you have to offer, resulting in higher conversion rates and improved ROI.

### **Cost-Effective Marketing**

Compared to other digital marketing strategies like paid advertising, SEO offers a cost-effective long-term solution.

While paid ads can provide immediate results, they require ongoing investment.

In contrast, SEO efforts continue to yield results over time. By consistently optimizing your website and staying on top of algorithm updates, you can enjoy sustained organic traffic without constantly paying for clicks or impressions.

### **Enhanced User Experience**

SEO is not solely about keyword rankings; it also focuses on delivering a seamless user experience.

Search engines value websites that provide a positive user experience, such as fast loading times, easy navigation, and mobile responsiveness.

By optimizing your website for these factors, you not only improve your chances of ranking higher but also create a better experience for your visitors. A user-friendly website encourages visitors to stay longer, explore more pages, and ultimately engage with your business.

### **Brand Credibility and Authority**

Appearing on the first page of search results gives your brand credibility and authority in the eyes of your potential customers.

Users tend to trust websites that rank higher, considering them to be more reliable and trustworthy.

By consistently implementing effective SEO strategies, you can establish your brand as a leader in your industry and foster trust with your target audience.

## Technical SEO Services

Source: https://prosperitymedia.com.au/technical-seo-agency/

# Technical SEO Agency

A team of highly skilled Technical SEOs

Technical SEO may be invisible to most website visitors, but it’s fundamental to every successful organic search strategy.

Without solid technical foundations in place, search engines will struggle to crawl and index your website. No amount of high-quality content or link building will matter if search engines can’t find or interpret your site properly.

At **Prosperity Media**, we’re a full-service SEO agency that builds long-term performance into your website’s backbone. We combine deep technical expertise with advanced modelling that mimics real search engine behaviour. This means your site isn’t just indexed; it climbs search engine rankings and shows sustained growth over time.

## **Why Technical SEO Matters**

Search engines don’t see your website the way humans do. They use automated crawlers that need access, structure, clarity, and performance signals. This helps them trust your website and determine where your pages belong in the search results.

Technical SEO ensures your site:

- Is discoverable and crawlable by search engine bots
- Loads quickly and performs well across devices
- Has a logical architecture and site hierarchy
- Uses structured data that helps search engines understand context
- Reduces crawl waste and avoids indexing dead content

When the technical elements of your site are sound, your content creation and marketing efforts can reach their full potential. Without it, your rankings are unpredictable and fragile. As a result, your website will be limited in the organic traffic it attracts.

## **How We Apply Technical SEO**

Our technical SEO services go beyond surface-level checks. We use a 100-point checklist to dig into your website and identify exactly what’s holding it back.

Our comprehensive [technical SEO audits](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-audits/) are modelled on how real search engines crawl and index pages, meaning issues are revealed in the same way Google or other search engine crawlers would see them.

We then prioritise the improvements that will make the biggest impact, providing clear direction on fixing technical issues and collaborating closely with your team to bring your website’s performance up to an optimal level.

You can find out more about our unique approach by reading our [definitive technical SEO checklist](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/definitive-technical-seo-checklist-for-brands/).

### **Crawlability and Indexation**

We evaluate your site’s crawl behaviour in depth. This includes robots.txt rules, canonicalisation, XML sitemap configuration, and crawl budget optimisation. Our aim is to ensure search engines can crawl your important pages efficiently without wasting resources on low-value URLs.

### **Site Performance and Page Speed**

Speed isn’t optional. A slow website creates a frustrating user experience that leads potential customers to quickly leave the site. We analyse load times, Core Web Vitals, image optimisation, CSS and JavaScript efficiency, and server performance to ensure your site doesn’t lag behind competitors.

### **Mobile Optimisation**

With mobile-first indexing now standard, mobile optimisation and mobile usability are critical technical elements. We ensure your site delivers a smooth experience across devices, supporting mobile friendliness, user satisfaction, and stronger search results.

### **Structured Data and Markup**

Schema and structured data give search engines the context they need to properly understand your content. With precise structured data implementation, we increase your likelihood of appearing in rich results, featured snippets, and AI overviews.

### **Architecture and Internal Linking**

A logical site architecture pleases both users and search engines. We assess site structure, internal linking, orphaned URLs, and hierarchy depth. This enables us to improve crawl paths, distribute authority between pages, and strengthen your site’s overall search visibility.

### **URL Structure and Redirects**

Clean URLs and accurate redirect mapping reduce friction for search engine crawlers. We fix inefficient redirect chains, resolve broken pages, and optimise URL structures to prevent wasted crawl budget that can dilute your SEO efforts.

### **Error Detection and Resolution**

It’s often the simplest technical issues that undermine performance. We identify any broken links, server errors, soft 404s, and indexation problems that are holding back your search engine performance and organic traffic.

## **Collaboration With Your Teams**

Technical SEO is rarely a solo initiative. It requires cooperation with developers, product teams, and digital leads.

Our technical SEO experts speak the languages of SEO and website development fluently. We provide:

- Prioritised recommendations based on impact and effort

## **FAQs**

### **What is technical SEO?**

Technical SEO is the part of search engine optimisation that improves how search engines crawl, index, and interpret your website. It focuses on backend elements like site speed, structure, architecture, structured data, and more.

### **Why is technical SEO important?**

Search engines need access to your site’s content and structure to rank it. If your site isn’t discoverable, fast, or technically sound, it will struggle to rank regardless of content quality.

### **How long does a technical SEO audit take?**

Depending on the size and complexity of your site, a full technical SEO audit typically takes a few days to complete. Larger enterprise sites may take longer, but you will receive prioritised insights early in the process.

### **Do you work with development teams?**

Yes, our technical SEO consultants work closely with in-house developers or digital teams to ensure recommendations are implemented with minimal disruption and maximum impact. Many of our team come from web development and systems backgrounds, allowing us to consult confidently on even the most complex projects.

### **How do you measure success?**

We measure success through improvements in crawlability, site speed, error reduction, indexation health, and ultimately, visibility in search results and organic performance metrics.

### **Is technical SEO a one-time fix?**

No, technical SEO evolves with search engine algorithms and site changes. Ongoing maintenance and optimisation help maintain rankings and adapt to new challenges.

## ChatGPT Optimisation Services

Source: https://prosperitymedia.com.au/chatgpt-optimisation-service/

# ChatGPT Optimisation Service

Every brand should be preparing for OpenAIs search engine; searchGPT. It gives your website a chance to find new customers and if you’re not making the most of it then your competitors will be. This not only ensures you’re future-proofing but also ensures that your revenue-earning potential is as high as possible.

As an SEO agency with a decade of experience, we’ve seen the development of AI first-hand. To optimise your website for SearchGPT, [send us a message](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/contact/). 

## What is SearchGPT?

[SearchGPT](https://openai.com/index/searchgpt-prototype/) is a search engine developed by OpenAI that uses AI to better understand searcher queries and provide highly relevant and precise answers.

SearchGPT’s conversational interface allows for a more natural and intuitive search experience, responding quickly and directly to questions with relevant sources and clear links.

SearchGPT is designed to give you an answer, not just a list of links. With its innovative approach, SearchGPT aims to transform the way people search for information online. OpenAI wants to combine the best of a search engine and LLMs.

## Will SEO Work with SearchGPT?

Yes, SEO will work with SearchGPT because OpenAI still needs to process large amounts of data in a similar way to Google. This means there will be an algorithm in place that websites can optimise for.

At our SEO agency, we’ve already seen SEO strategies work for SGE AI Overviews in Google. It’s reasonable to assume that SearchGPT will be similar. However, SearchGPT is currently still in a ‘temporary prototype’ phase so there’s still a lot to be decided. Our team will be testing out strategies as it gets a wider release.

While SearchGPT’s AI-driven technology may change how search results are presented, the fundamentals of SEO will likely remain the same. By focusing on quality, relevance, and user experience, you’ll give your website the best chance of succeeding. Remember that SEO isn’t a one-time task, but an ongoing process.

SEO Strategies for SearchGPT

SearchGPT SEO strategies can prepare your website for this new search engine and are likely to follow the same principles as SEO for other search engines. Being an SEO agency we’ve witnessed tried and tested to find out what works.

### Keyword and Entity Optimisation

When optimising for SearchGPT, you’ll want to focus on keyword and entity optimisation strategies that help the AI-driven algorithms quickly identify the key points of your content and match it with relevant user queries.

This involves using relevant keywords in your content, including titles, headings, and body text. However, it’s essential to use them naturally and not overdo it.

Entity optimisation is also important, as it helps SearchGPT understand the context and relevance of your content. By optimising your content for keywords and entities, you’ll improve its relevance and chance of ranking in SearchGPT’s search results. Also, use a conversational tone and natural language in your content to match voice search queries.

### Structured Data

By incorporating structured data into your website, you can help SearchGPT’s AI-driven algorithms better understand your content, making it more discoverable and increasing its chances of appearing in search results.

This is especially important for SearchGPT, as it relies on natural language processing to interpret user queries and provide accurate answers. By providing clear and concise structured data, you can help SearchGPT’s algorithms quickly identify the key points of your content and match them with relevant user queries.

To optimize your website for SearchGPT, focus on using schema markup to provide additional context about your content. This can include details such as author names, publication dates, and keywords.

By using schema markup, you can help SearchGPT’s algorithms better understand the structure and content of your website, making it more likely to appear in search results.

### Digital PR & High-quality Backlinks

Our SEO agency has seen great success with building backlinks through [Digital PR](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/digital-pr-agency/) for brands. In fact, we have a dedicated PR team that has generated hundreds of high DR links for clients. 

We achieve this by crafting compelling stories and pitches that showcase your brand’s expertise and unique value proposition. Reach out to reputable publications, media outlets, and influencers in your industry to secure features, interviews, and reviews that link back to your website.

By leveraging digital PR, you can also improve your website’s visibility and ranking on SearchGPT. This is because high-quality backlinks from authoritative sources signal to the AI algorithms that your content is trustworthy and worthy of citation.

Digital PR can also help you build relationships with key stakeholders, including journalists, influencers, and industry leaders, which can lead to further opportunities for collaboration and promotion.

To maximise the impact of digital PR on your SearchGPT optimisation, we focus on quality over quantity. This will help you build a strong foundation and improve your website’s credibility and authority in the eyes of SearchGPT’s AI algorithms.

### Optimising Content for Search Intent

To optimise your content for search intent and improve your SearchGPT rankings, you need to understand the different types of search intent and tailor your content to match the user’s query.

There are four main types of search intent:

1. Informational
2. Navigational
3. Transactional
4. Commercial

Understanding the user’s intent behind their search query will help you create content that meets their needs and provides a better user experience. For example, if a user searches for ‘best manufacturer in Sydney,’ their intent is likely transactional. They’re looking for a specific type of business in a specific location.

With AI search results getting more intelligent and specific; search intent is going to matter even more.

## Why is E-E-A-T Important?

Your online credibility relies heavily on demonstrating E-E-A-T. Especially if you’re in a YMYL niche.

E-E-A-T stands for Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness.

By showcasing your E-E-A-T, you can establish your brand as a reliable source of information, increasing your chances of ranking higher in search engine results pages (SERPs). Google uses E-E-A-T to assess the credibility of a website or content creator so it’s probable SearchGPT will also.

If you demonstrate a high level of E-E-A-T, you’re more likely to be considered a trustworthy source, and your content will be promoted accordingly. On the other hand, if your E-E-A-T is lacking, your ranking may suffer.

By focusing on building your E-E-A-T, you can improve your online reputation, increase your visibility, and drive more traffic to your website.

## How Will SEO Develop with SearchGPT?

Understanding how to adapt your optimisation strategies will be important to staying ahead of the curve. Taking time to strategise now will be beneficial in the long run.

We recommend brands optimise for the [digital shelf](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/digital-shelf-optimisation/) to have a single overarching strategy. This means having a plan to optimise your brand everywhere it appears on the internet, AKA the digital shelf. 

You’ll need to focus on creating high-quality, user-centric content that meets searchers’ needs. SearchGPT’s emphasis on providing direct answers to user queries means that your content should be concise, informative, and engaging.

As AI-driven search becomes more prevalent, you’ll need to stay up-to-date with the latest developments in AI. You should also focus on providing a seamless user experience, using methods like E-E-A-T to establish credibility and trust with your audience. By adapting to these changes, you can ensure that your SEO strategy remains effective in the age of SearchGPT.

## **What is Ecommerce SEO?**

Ecommerce SEO refers to the practice of optimizing ecommerce websites for search engines to increase visibility and drive organic traffic.

It’s a crucial aspect of online marketing as it helps an online store rank higher on search engine results pages (SERPs) and attracts potential customers.

To excel at ecommerce SEO, it is essential to understand how search engine optimization works and familiarise yourself with best practices.

By conducting thorough keyword research, you can identify keywords that have the potential to bring in targeted traffic.

This involves considering factors such as search volume, competition level, relevancy to your products, the authority of the website ranking for those keywords, and most importantly – commercial intent.

By focusing on commercial keywords that indicate buying intent from users searching for products similar to yours, you can optimize the content of eCommerce websites and attract qualified leads who are more likely to convert into paying customers.

## **How To Rank An Ecommerce Website**

In order to rank an ecommerce website, you need the perfect storm of strategy and implementation.

Developing an eCommerce SEO strategy gives you the road map on how to rank for specific keywords but without implementation it means nothing.

The first step in ranking ecommerce websites is to build an SEO strategy.

This involves taking a look at competitors and planning out keyword research.

Once the strategy is built, you’ll want to run a technical audit of your site to check there’s nothing holding it back.

Once the site is deemed healthy, you’ll have to start building out content and landing pages that target keywords from the strategy.

The last step would be to build links to content assets and interlink them to your collection pages that drive revenue.

After the links have been built you’ll start to see some real improvements in rankings over the course of 3-6+ months.

### **Site Architecture**

A well-structured site architecture plays a crucial role in enhancing the overall user experience, ensuring that visitors can easily navigate through your website and find what they’re looking for.

This, in turn, leads to higher engagement and increased conversions.

Additionally, a strong site architecture helps search engines understand the organisation of your website and index it more efficiently, which can positively impact your rankings.

This can be difficult for an eCommerce website where there are a large number of pages, often with similar content.

To keep things organised, you need to remember these two things:

1. Establish a simple site structure that’s easy to scale
2. Keep every page fewer than three clicks away from your homepage

This will make sure that your site is not only easy to navigate, but that the link authority from your homepage flows through your site.

There are more advanced techniques such as canonicalizing the most important version of a page so Google knows which version to show.

You can also set up breadcrumbs so that there are navigation links on product pages to get back to the category page and homepage.

Your eCommerce platform may or may not do these things for you.

Site architecture and everything that comes with it can be complex, if you’re unsure it’s best to contact an experienced SEO agency.

### **On-Page SEO for Ecommerce**

One crucial aspect of on-page optimization is conducting thorough keyword research.

By identifying the most relevant and high-performing keywords for your ecommerce business, you can strategically incorporate them into your product pages, URLs, meta tags, and headings.

However, it’s important to avoid keyword stuffing or repetition as this can make your store look spammy and negatively impact user experience.

Another key factor in on-page SEO for ecommerce is optimizing your product descriptions.

Instead of resorting to thin content or generic descriptions, aim for longer and unique descriptions that provide important details about each product.

This not only helps improve the ranking of your product pages but also enhances the overall user experience.

Including relevant keywords throughout the page, content helps Google understand what the product is about and improves its accuracy in ranking the page.

By implementing effective on-page SEO strategies such as keyword research, optimizing product descriptions, prioritising user experience, and incorporating internal links, you can improve your website’s visibility in search results while providing a seamless shopping experience for potential customers.

### **Link Building**

A strong and diverse link profile is essential for improving your ecommerce SEO.

One effective link-building SEO strategy is guest blogging, where you contribute high-quality articles to authoritative websites in your industry.

This not only helps establish your expertise and credibility but also allows you to include links back to your online store in the author bio or within the content itself.

Remember that when implementing any link-building strategy for ecommerce SEO, it’s crucial to focus on quality over quantity.

Prioritise authoritative sites with high domain authority and relevance to ensure that the links you acquire are valuable and beneficial for your online store’s search engine visibility.

### **Content Marketing**

To effectively promote your products and [drive traffic to your online store](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/ecommerce-content-marketing-strategies/), you need to focus on creating compelling and valuable content. 

Content marketing plays a crucial role in increasing brand awareness, engaging with your target audience, and ultimately driving conversions.

Here are some key strategies to consider:

- Social media: Utilise popular social media platforms to share your content and engage with potential customers. Create captivating posts that highlight the benefits of your products and encourage users to visit your website.
- Influencer marketing: Collaborate with influencers in your industry who have a large following and can promote your products to their audience. This can help increase brand visibility and credibility.
- Email marketing: Build an email list of interested customers and regularly send them valuable content related to your products. This helps nurture leads and encourages repeat purchases.
- Video content: Incorporate video into your content marketing strategy as it’s highly engaging and shareable. Create product demonstrations, tutorials, or behind-the-scenes videos that showcase the unique features of your products.
- User-generated content: Encourage customers to share their experiences with your products through reviews, testimonials, or social media posts. This not only adds credibility but also creates a sense of community around your brand.

By implementing these content marketing strategies, you can effectively reach and engage with potential customers while promoting your eCommerce store.

## **What Are The Best Ecommerce SEO Tools?**

That largely depends on who you ask because there are heaps of them.

Our favourites at Prosperity are Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb and SurferSEO.

Ahrefs and Semrush are the Swiss army knives of SEO tools. 

They are multipurpose tools that allow you to do various things such as keyword research, link audits, competitive analysis and even rank tracking.

Screaming Frog and Sitebulb allow you to crawl your site and poke around for technical issues.

Fixing technical issues is often underrated but very important. They could be holding your site back from ranking and you might not even know it.

SurferSEO gives you the ability to optimize your on-page SEO for ecommerce sites and regular sites. It tells you exactly what to put on your pages to optimize them for search engines.

## **What are Common Ecommerce SEO Mistakes?**

When it comes to ecommerce SEO, there are several common mistakes that can hinder your website’s success.

### **Duplicate Content**

Duplicate content refers to identical or very similar content that appears on multiple pages of a website.

This can negatively impact your search engine rankings and result in penalties from search engines.

To avoid duplicate content issues, it’s important to implement canonical tags on your web pages.

Canonical tags inform search engines which version of a page is the preferred one, eliminating confusion and preventing penalties.

This will help improve your organic traffic and prevent any potential negative consequences associated with duplicate content penalties.

### **Too Many Pages**

Overwhelmed by the sheer number of pages on your website, it’s easy to feel lost and frustrated.

There’s no easy way to get around this, you’ll need to go through all your pages and find out which ones *aren’t* generating any revenue or traffic. 

It’s a good idea to think about removing these products and pages. You can then delete, no index, or redirect those pages while cleaning up your site.

One important aspect of page optimization is ensuring that your URL structure is concise, descriptive, and includes relevant keywords.

This not only helps search engines understand the content of your pages but also makes it easier for users to navigate through your site.

### **Thin Content**

Now that we’ve addressed the issue of having too many pages on your ecommerce website, let’s move on to another important aspect of eCommerce SEO: thin content.

Thin content refers to pages on your site that have very little or low-quality content. These pages may not provide enough value or information to users, which can negatively impact your rankings in search engines.

Conducting thorough keyword research can help you identify the right keywords to target and incorporate into your content. By strategically using these keywords throughout your product and category pages, you can improve their relevance and visibility in search results.

### **Site Speed**

Slow loading times can frustrate visitors and lead them to abandon your site, resulting in lost online sales and revenue.

Also, search engines like Google consider site speed as one of the ranking factors, meaning that a slow website may struggle to appear higher in search results.

To improve site speed for your ecommerce website, there are several key areas you should focus on.

Firstly, mobile optimization is essential since an increasing number of shoppers use their smartphones or tablets to browse and make purchases.

Ensure that your website is responsive and optimized for mobile devices to provide a seamless experience for mobile users.

Secondly, image optimization is crucial as large image files can significantly slow down page loading times.

Compressing images without sacrificing quality can help reduce file sizes and improve site speed.

Implementing caching techniques allows browsers to store certain elements of your website locally, reducing the need for repeated downloads when users revisit pages.

Integrating a Content Delivery Network (CDN) can also help distribute your website’s content across multiple servers worldwide, delivering it more efficiently to users around the globe.

## **What Does Law Firm SEO Involve?**

Every SEO strategy is different because every legal firm is different. A small, family-owned legal company in rural Western Australia has different goals and clients compared to a large criminal defence firm in Sydney.

That said, all successful SEO for law firms rests on four core pillars:

### **1. Technical SEO for Law Firms**

Technical SEO ensures search engines can fully understand and properly index your law firm’s website. Without a solid technical foundation, even the best-written content will struggle to appear in relevant search engine results.

Many law firm websites unknowingly suffer from issues such as:

- Slow load times
- Poorly structured pages
- Missing schema
- Duplicate content
- Messy internal linking
- Outdated plugins or old CMS structures

Search engines prioritise websites that are fast, accessible, and easy for both users and crawlers to navigate. Once these underlying issues are identified, the next step is implementing the improvements to enhance your firm’s online visibility.

#### **Key technical SEO improvements for law firm websites include:**

- Correct legal schema markup (LocalBusiness, LegalService, Attorney)
- A clean, intuitive site architecture
- Logical internal linking between practice areas
- Mobile responsiveness
- Fast page speed
- XML sitemaps and accurate robots.txt files
- Optimised titles, headings, and meta descriptions
- Secure HTTPS and best-practice hosting

#### **Why these optimisations matter:**

Someone searching for “assault lawyer” or “binding financial agreement solicitor” wants answers fast. If your website loads slowly or feels confusing, they’ll hit the back button and try another firm. Google notices that behaviour, and your rankings will reflect it. In an industry where clients often make decisions under pressure, a technically sound website can be the difference between a new case and a lost lead.

### **2. Local SEO for Lawyers and Law Firms**

Local SEO determines whether your firm appears in Google’s map pack — one of the most valuable placements for law firms. When someone searches for legal help, proximity, trust, and convenience matter. Most people prefer a lawyer who is nearby, especially for:

- Criminal law
- Family law
- Wills and estates
- Property disputes
- Personal injury

Strong local SEO ensures your firm appears when someone searches:

- “Criminal lawyer near me”
- “Family lawyer Sydney CBD”
- “Compensation lawyer Newcastle”
- “Solicitor Campbelltown”

Once your firm is eligible to appear in local search, the next step is strengthening the signals that improve your position and help you stand out among competing law firms.

#### **Local SEO strategies we implement:**

- Optimising your Google Business Profile
- Ensuring NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency across the web
- Creating localised content for each office location
- Building suburb- or region-specific practice area pages
- Acquiring local citations and local backlinks
- Developing a Google review strategy that boosts trust and visibility

#### **Why these optimisations matter:**

Local search results are highly competitive, especially in areas saturated with solicitors and specialist practices. Strong local SEO increases your firm’s visibility to nearby prospective clients at the exact moment they are searching for legal help. For multi-office practices, it also ensures every location receives equal visibility — rather than relying on a single site to rank everywhere.

### **3. Content Marketing for Lawyers**

Good legal SEO content is not generic filler. It must be structured, researched, and legally accurate. Crucially, it also needs to be written in a way that real people can understand. Your prospective clients are often anxious, stressed, and unsure of their options. Clear and empathetic content builds trust before they ever speak to you.

Most law firms make one of two mistakes:

- Publishing thin, generic content that doesn’t stand out
- Writing overly technical content that confuses non-lawyers

Prosperity takes a different approach, with every piece of content backed by deep research and an even deeper connection with the reader.

#### **Our legal content framework includes:**

- Keyword research based on real search behaviour
- Mapping a content strategy alongside the client journey (awareness → consideration → action)
- Avoiding keyword cannibalisation
- Developing structured, readable practice area pages
- Writing legally accurate information in plain language
- Publishing supporting articles that build topical authority

#### **Why these optimisations matter:**

Clients want answers they can understand, delivered clearly and compassionately. A well-structured content strategy positions your firm as both authoritative and approachable. It builds trust, increases visibility, and guides prospective clients toward contacting your team.

Consider how these examples outperform generic content:

Instead of “What is personal injury law?”, we create pages like:

- “What to Do After a Workplace Injury in NSW”
- “How Long Do You Have to Lodge a Workers Compensation Claim?”
- “Average Payouts for Personal Injury Claims in Australia”

This is the kind of content that earns rankings, visibility, and enquiries, because it reflects what people actually search for, and what they need to know.

### **4. Link Building for Law Firms**

Link building is one of the top three ranking factors in Google’s algorithm, and no law firm can succeed in SEO without authoritative backlinks.

However, not all backlinks are beneficial. Links from low-quality directories, irrelevant sites and manipulative link schemes can actively damage your search engine visibility and your firm’s reputation.

**Prosperity Media** uses a transparent, white-hat link acquisition process designed around legal credibility and long-term SEO success.

#### **Our legal link-building process includes:**

**Strategic legal content creation**

**Targeted outreach**

**Community-based link earning**

**Digital PR campaigns**

[campaigns that generate national coverage from major news outlets, ensuring your firm earns high-authority links that Google respects.](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/digital-pr-agency/)

**digital PR**
#### **Why these optimisations matter:**

Authoritative backlinks act as votes of confidence. They help Google understand not only that your law firm exists, but that it is credible, reputable, and trustworthy. These are the kinds of links that move legal websites steadily up the rankings and keep them there.

### **How SEO and PPC Work Together**

Law firms often ask our team whether SEO or pay-per-click (PPC) delivers better results. The truth is that both work, but they work in very different ways.

PPC delivers immediate visibility. If a firm needs enquiries today, paid search will put you at the top of Google instantly. The trade-off is cost. In the legal industry, cost per click can range from AUD $60 to $150+, especially for competitive areas like personal injury, criminal law, and family law. For most firms, that level of spend is difficult to sustain month after month.

SEO takes longer to ramp up, but it becomes more profitable over time. High-quality SEO helps your law firm:

- Build authority and trust
- Appear across more relevant search engine results pages
- Reduce long-term cost per acquisition
- Generate enquiries long after content has been published

In other words, PPC buys visibility while SEO earns it. The strongest law firms use both together.

Short PPC campaigns provide fast, real-world data about which keywords convert, how potential clients describe their legal problems, and which practice areas deliver the highest return.

That data then shapes an SEO strategy that targets the most valuable search terms, builds visibility in specific suburbs, and increases organic traffic without relying on ongoing ad spend.

Meanwhile, PPC continues to support:

- Urgent, time-sensitive matters (for example, bail applications or AVO cases)
- Highly competitive personal injury searches
- Campaigns targeting specific suburbs or postcodes

Ultimately, SEO brings sustainable growth, while PPC brings speed and reliable data. Together, they form a balanced, high-ROI marketing strategy that supports both short-term demand and long-term profitability.

Search behaviour is changing rapidly. More Australians are turning to AI search tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot for legal questions and first-step advice.

If your content is not structured for these platforms, your firm risks losing visibility in the next major shift of search.

Prosperity Media’s content team works to ensure your articles, guides, and practice pages are fully optimised for both traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven answer engines. This includes:

- Structuring content to be easily understood and cited by AI models
- Creating clear, concise answers that appear in LLMs
- Using schema to help AI crawlers understand your services
- Designing content that works for both human readers and AI crawlers
- Applying query fanout so crawlers surface more of your content
- Building topical authority so your firm becomes one of the default sources an AI tool trusts

## SEO Strategy Development

## **How Long Does SEO Take?**

It’s important to understand that the timeline can vary widely depending on your specific circumstances.

Typically, some companies may start to notice improvements within four weeks, but a more realistic expectation is several months to achieve significant outcomes. This variation is influenced by factors such as the historical performance of your website, the level of competition in your medical industry, and the quality of the SEO strategies employed.

Websites with previous performance issues may require more time to see progress. Implementing high-quality SEO techniques is what will get you sustainable results.

## **The Challenges of SEO for Healthcare**

Healthcare has regulations set by authorities like AHPRA that pose challenges for SEO in the healthcare industry. It’s important to ensure compliance while creating content. This requires a careful balance between employing effective SEO strategies and not falling foul of regulations.

Healthcare is also one of the most competitive industries. Part of this is because it’s a YMYL category so you will be subject to stricter regulations from Google. Search engines only want medical content in the search engine results pages if they know it’s from a trustworthy source. This is why medical websites must build their authority in conjunction with search engine optimisation.

## **How is Healthcare SEO Different?**

Content must be accurate and comply with regulatory standards to maintain credibility and trustworthiness. This specificity extends to the audience, which includes health-conscious individuals, patients, their families, and healthcare professionals. The content must address their specific, often urgent, search needs with appropriate keywords and information.

Healthcare SEO will require more work than other industries which means you need more experience to perform well. Your business will need a backlink strategy as this will build trust in the eyes of Google.

SEO in healthcare focuses on improving the ranking of a medical practice’s website through search engines. It strategically targets increasing the website’s rank for carefully selected keywords that are directly related to the healthcare services provided. This draws more potential patients to your services.

### **How Much Does Medical SEO Cost?**

Medical SEO costs range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month. This variation depends on factors such as the scope of services, the competitiveness of targeted keywords, and the degree of customisation required.
