## Frequently Asked Questions

### What should I look for in an SEO agency?

When choosing SEO companies, focus on their experience, industry expertise, transparency in communication and track record of delivering results. Ensure they offer a comprehensive strategy that will align with your business objectives.

### How do I know if an SEO agency uses ethical practices?

Ask the agency to explain its SEO methods and request detailed reports on its activities. Avoid agencies that guarantee results or use black hat techniques like buying links, which can harm your website in the long term.

### What are the typical costs of SEO services?

SEO pricing varies widely depending on the scope of work and the agency’s experience. Common pricing models include monthly retainers, project-based fees and performance-based pricing. When evaluating pricing, focus on the potential ROI and long-term benefits.

### How long does it take to see SEO results?

SEO is a long-term strategy. It typically takes several months to see significant results, although the timeline can vary depending on your industry, competition and website’s current state.

### How involved do I need to be in the SEO process?

While your SEO agency will handle the technical aspects, your involvement can also be crucial for success. You provide industry insights, approve content and ensure that SEO strategies align with your business goals.

### What if I already have an in-house SEO team?

The right SEO company can complement your in-house team by providing specialised expertise, handling complex tasks or offering a fresh perspective on your strategy. They can also help scale your efforts or manage specific projects like technical audits or large-scale link-building campaigns.

### Will an SEO agency handle content creation and optimisation?

Most SEO agencies offer content creation and optimisation as part of their services. They can develop SEO-friendly content, optimise existing content and ensure your website’s messaging aligns with your overall SEO strategy to drive traffic and improve rankings. Other services that the best SEO companies might handle include search engine marketing services and other aspects of your digital marketing efforts.

## Bing SEO Optimization Guide

Source: https://prosperitymedia.com.au/bing-seo-how-to-optimise-your-website/

# Bing SEO: How to Optimise Your Website

If you’re not optimising for Bing you’re missing out on clicks and customers. We’ve seen great results with Bing SEO as part of our [SEO services](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-agency/) and you can do the same. 

Focusing on Bing-specific strategies, we help businesses capture untapped market share, achieving a well-rounded, effective SEO presence complementing their overall search engine strategy. We’ve created this article to help you do the same.

## Understanding the Importance of Bing SEO

While Google dominates the worldwide search engine market, Bing holds a significant share that businesses need to pay attention to. Bing controls around [6-9%](https://searchengineland.com/one-year-later-little-change-to-microsoft-bing-search-market-share-437238) of the market and continues to grow. It’s even higher in certain regions and demographics.

[Bing’s integration with Microsoft](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2023/02/07/reinventing-search-with-a-new-ai-powered-microsoft-bing-and-edge-your-copilot-for-the-web/) products like Windows and Office means it’s the default search engine for users, especially in corporate settings. By optimising for Bing, businesses can reach a segment of the market they’d miss if they focus solely on Google.

## Key Bing Ranking Factors

According to the Bing Webmaster Guidelines, on-page SEO is crucial to ranking well on Bing, with particular attention to elements like meta tags, content relevance and keyword usage.

Bing search results tend to value exact-match keywords more than we see in Google SEO, so it’s essential to incorporate them strategically into titles, headers and meta descriptions.

Meta tags aren’t as critical for Google rankings but can be a ranking factor for Bing. So ensuring optimised meta tags can boost search performance.

Another key area is content relevance. Bing’s algorithm favours clear, concise content directly related to a search query. Content likely to perform well is logically structured and strongly focused on the primary keyword.

Bing also prioritises content by answering questions directly, so effective strategies can include integrating FAQs or structured data.

In our experience, some of the main takeaways for on-page Bing SEO include:

- Use exact match keywords in meta tags and titles.
- Structure content well with clear headings and subheadings.
- Use structured data to enhance content relevance and improve search visibility.
- Regularly update content to maintain relevance because Bing considers fresh and updated content in rankings.

### Off-Page SEO for Bing

Off-page SEO for Bing focuses heavily on social signals, backlinks and brand authority. The algorithm puts more emphasis on social media engagement than Google, so an active presence on platforms like Facebook, X and LinkedIn may impact rankings. Encouraging social shares and interactions is a good way to boost your site’s authority from the perspective of Bing’s algorithm.

Bing tends to value the quality of backlinks over the quantity, so links from authoritative sites, especially when relevant to your industry, can have a substantial impact.

Ensuring your brand is consistently mentioned on reputable websites can enhance your visibility and authority.

Insights from our work and experience to keep in mind include:

- Focus on relationship building with authoritative sites for quality backlinks.
- Engage actively on social media.
- Monitor and encourage brand mentions to boost brand authority.
- Bing highly values using social platforms to share content and encourage interaction.

### Technical Signals for Bing

As with Google, technical SEO is another cornerstone of Bing’s ranking algorithm. The search engine emphasises site structure, mobile friendliness and crawlability.

A well-structured site with a logical hierarchy of pages and a clean URL structure is more likely to perform well on Bing.

Mobile friendliness is a main ranking feature for Bing, so ensure your site is responsive and provides a seamless experience across all devices.

Bing’s crawler is sensitive to issues like slow-loading pages or broken links. The search engine favours easily crawlable sites with a clear sitemap and minimal technical issues that could otherwise impede effective indexing.

Examples of common technical issues that may be negatively affecting Bing rankings include:

- Broken links and slow page load speeds.
- Lacking a clear, logical site structure.
- Not regularly updating your sitemap.

## Bing Webmaster Tools

Bing Webmaster Tools is an essential platform for any business wanting to optimise its search engine presence. It’s like Google Search Console but specifically for Bing’s search results to maximise your Bing search traffic. Setting up your account provides insights to help fine-tune your SEO strategy.

To set up your account, you do the following:

- Create or if you have one, sign in to your Microsoft account.
- Add your website to Bing Webmaster Tools.
- Verify ownership of your website.
- Configure your website settings.

Once your site is verified on Bing Webmaster Tools, you will get access to a set of features that are especially useful for enterprise-level SEO.

- **Keyword research** : Bing Webmaster Tools provides detailed data on keywords so you can see what you’re currently ranking for and identify new opportunities. The Keyword Research tool lets you discover relevant high-performing keywords and provides insights into the trends to inform your content strategy, helping you stay ahead of competitors.
- **Backlink analysis** : The Backlinks tool allows you to analyse the quality and quantity of backlinks pointing to your site and identify opportunities to acquire more high-authority links. The tool also helps you monitor backlink growth over time.
- **Site audits** : The SEO Reports section provides actionable insights into duplicate content, crawl errors and broken links. You can do a comprehensive site scan to audit for technical SEO agencies and ensure your site is in optimal health.
- **Indexing and crawl control:** Bing provides tools to manage how its crawler interacts with your site. You can submit URLs for immediate indexing, control crawl rates, and view crawl error reports. Use the Submit URLs tool to make sure your most important content is promptly indexed, especially if you make significant updates. To avoid server overload during periods of high traffic, the Crawl Control feature lets you adjust the crawl speed.

## Advanced Bing SEO Strategies

From our experience working with clients on Bing optimisation, the following are key points to remember.

### Leveraging Social Media for Bing SEO

Bing’s integration with social media platforms is a distinctive feature, setting it apart from other search engines, especially when compared to Google. Bing actively considers social media engagement as a ranking factor.

Bing’s algorithm uses signals from social media platforms to assess your content’s popularity and relevance. The more your content is shared and engaged on social media, the more Bing recognises it as valuable and relevant.

Consistent social media activity can boost your brand authority, which is also important in the Bing ranking algorithm.

Ensure your business is active on major social media platforms and regularly posts content encouraging interaction like questions and polls. Focus on sharing high-quality, relevant content. The more content resonates with your audience, the more likely it is to be shared, increasing your social signals.

Integrate social sharing buttons directly on your site, actively monitor social media mentions and respond to interactions.

### Local SEO and Bing

Local SEO should be part of a comprehensive SEO strategy, including on Bing. Bing emphasises local search results, so it’s an important platform for businesses with physical locations or those targeting specific regions.

Bing Places, Bing’s equivalent of Google My Business, lets businesses manage their online presence. Optimising your listing helps you appear in local search results.

Your Bing Places for Business profile must be fully complete with accurate information. Relevant local keywords should be incorporated into your business description.

Encourage customer reviews. Positive ones can boost your local search rankings and add visual content like photos and videos to your Bing Places profile.

### Voice Search Optimization for Big

As more users turn to voice-activated devices like Cortana and Amazon Alexa, optimising for voice search has become increasingly important to maintain visibility on Bing.

Voice searches are more conversational and natural than traditional text searches. The Bing algorithm can understand these natural language queries, so optimising based on natural language processing and voice search can improve your ranking potential.

Voice searches often use longer specific phrases. Bing tends to favour content answering long-tail queries directly.

With these things in mind, advanced strategies for optimising content for voice search include:

- **Use conversational language:** Write content in a tone that replicates how people speak so that it’s easier for Bing to match your content with voice search queries.
- **Focus on question-based keywords** : Voice searches often start with questions like “how” or “why.” Incorporate question-based keywords into your content, providing clear, concise answers.
- **Optimise for featured snippets** : Like Google, Bing often pulls voice search answers from featured snippets. Structure content to be snippet-friendly with bullet points, numbered lists and concise paragraphs.
- **Enhance local content** : Many voice searches are local, like finding nearby businesses or services. Ensure your local SEO is strong, with locally relevant keywords throughout your content.

## Measuring Success: Tracking and Analyzing Bing SEO Performance

Proper tracking mechanisms need to be set up to measure the success of Bing’s SEO efforts. Tracking allows you to monitor key performance indicators (KPI), gaining insight into how your optimisations affect rankings, traffic and conversions.

You can start tracking by linking your Bing Webmaster Tools account with your preferred analytics platform, like Google Analytics. The integration will let you track Bing-specific traffic and analyse user behaviour on your site.

In your analytics platform, create goals specific to Bing traffic and ensure they’re configured to differentiate between Bing and other traffic sources so you’re getting the clearest insights.

When running Bing-specific marketing campaigns, use URL UTM parameters to track campaign performance separately and see which Bing campaigns drive traffic and conversions.

Within your Bing Webmaster Tools, you can regularly review key metrics like keyword rankings, impressions, clicks and click-through rate (CTR).

When approaching analysis, you can do the following:

- Begin by comparing Bing search engine traffic volume and quality to other sources. Find patterns indicating whether Bing users are more engaged or likely to convert. Pay attention to bounce rates as well as metrics like average session duration and pages per session to see engagement and determine whether your SEO efforts resonate with your audience.
- Analyse conversion rates from Bing traffic compared to other traffic sources. Look at the keywords or pages driving the most conversions from Bing. If your Bing traffic is converting faster, consider focusing more on optimising for Bing-specific keywords.
- Use segment analysis for deep insights. Segment Bing traffic in your analytics platform to analyse specific user behaviours, identify user engagement, and how different groups interact with your site.
- Leverage the insights you gain during analysis to refine Bing SEO strategies.

### Continuously Improving Your Bing SEO Efforts and Strategy

As is true with Google, Bing SEO isn’t a one-time effort. It’s a continuous process. The Bing algorithm is regularly updated, and user behaviours are always evolving. To keep your Bing SEO strategy dynamic, regularly monitor algorithm changes.

Perform regular SEO audits, test and implement new strategies, and analyse competitor performance.

## Comparing Bing and Google

Bing’s search algorithm differs from Google’s in several key ways regarding ranking web pages, impacting the approach to SEO strategies.

While Google heavily emphasises backlinks and content relevance, Bing gives more weight to [on-page factors](https://www.semrush.com/blog/bing-vs-google/) like page titles, meta tags and exact match keywords. Additionally, Bing values social signals from platforms like Facebook more than Google, making social media integration a critical aspect of Bing’s SEO.

Another notable difference is in the handling of multimedia content. Bing favours sites incorporating rich media such as images, videos, and infographics. The emphasis means businesses can improve their visibility on Bing by optimising multimedia.

The differences necessitate a tailored SEO approach. Strategies that work well on Google might be less effective on Bing and vice versa. Understanding the nuances lets businesses refine their tactics and perform well across both search engines.

### Why Should Medium to Enterprise-Level Companies Care?

For medium to enterprise-level companies, ignoring Bing SEO means missing out on valuable traffic and revenue. While Google may bring in the bulk of search traffic, Bing’s user base represents a unique, potentially lucrative segment.

Focusing on Bing SEO can help companies diversify traffic sources and reduce reliance on a single platform. Diversification mitigates the risks associated with algorithm changes.

Bing users tend to have a higher conversion rate compared to those on Google, which may be due to demographics. Bing is used frequently by older and more affluent users who are further along in the buying cycle.

## SEO Pricing Explained

Source: https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-pricing-how-much-does-seo-cost/

# SEO Pricing: How Much Does SEO Cost?

SEO pricing can be a puzzle, with costs varying widely depending on business needs, industry and goals. Understanding how much SEO costs helps you make informed decisions driving your bottom line.

With over a decade of experience delivering impactful SEO strategies, we’re here to cut through the noise and demystify SEO pricing so you can invest confidently and see real results.

## How Much Does SEO Cost?

SEO costs from $3,000 to $10,000+ a month for an [experienced SEO agency](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/seo-agency/). But, the honest answer is there’s no one set price and there shouldn’t be. Every project is different and SEO should always work with your budget, not the other way around. 


Before we work with our clients we’ll arrange a free site audit and call so that we can understand what your website needs and what you want. This ensures that both parties are on the same page and we can work to a budget.


If you only take away one piece of advice from this article, it would be to ensure every SEO company does the same. To speak to our team, simply [send us a message](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/contact/) and we can take a look at your website. 

## Understanding SEO Pricing Models

To better understand SEO pricing, knowing the models companies use can help. Here are the main pricing models for SEO services and some things to watch out for.

### Hourly Rates

Hourly rates are a straightforward pricing model. You pay an SEO professional or agency for each hour they work on your project.

This is well-suited to short-term tasks or when specialised expertise is needed.

For medium—to enterprise-level companies, hourly rates can range from $150 to $500 an hour, depending on the agency’s experience and reputation.

The model is flexible, but you do have to monitor hours billed.

### Monthly Retainers

Monthly retainers are the most common model for ongoing SEO services to drive website traffic. With a retainer, you pay a fixed monthly SEO cost for keyword research, content creation for search engines, technical SEO and regular reporting.

The approach is ideal for larger companies needing continuous SEO work to stay competitive.

Monthly retainers can range from AUD 3,000 to 10,000 or more, depending on the complexity of the work and the enterprise’s size.

The predictability of costs and sustained focus on long-term goals favour the model among larger businesses.

### Project-Based Pricing

Project-based pricing is used for one-off SEO tasks or short-term projects with a defined beginning and end. Examples include a technical SEO overhaul, content strategy revamp or website audit.

The SEO cost in Australia for these projects varies widely depending on scope and complexity, with average SEO costs ranging from AUD 3,000 to AUD 10,000 for medium—to enterprise-level projects.

Project-based pricing provides clear deliverables and timelines, so it’s a good choice for a company that wants to tackle specific SEO challenges without a long-term commitment.

### Performance-Based Pricing

Pricing based on performance ties the cost of SEO services to results such as higher rankings or increased traffic.

Initially, this model can sound appealing, but it comes with risks, especially for enterprise clients.

The challenge lies in accurately defining and measuring success metrics, which is difficult in the ever-changing landscape of SEO.

Performance-based pricing could encourage SEO companies or an SEO consultant to focus on quick wins instead of sustained growth. While these models might work for smaller businesses with narrower goals, they are generally not recommended for enterprise-level SEO because of their unpredictability and potential for misaligned priorities.

## Factors Influencing SEO Costs

Some of the most impactful factors that influence the cost of SEO include:

### Industry Competition

In highly competitive industries, SEO costs are driven by the need to outperform numerous competitors vying for the same keywords and visibility. Industries like finance, real estate and e-commerce often require more aggressive, resource-intensive SEO strategies.

SEO professionals spend more time on advanced keyword research, high-quality content creation, and robust link-building efforts.

The more competition within an industry, the more investment is needed to gain and maintain a competitive edge in search rankings.

### Scope of Services

The scope of services needed plays a significant role in determining SEO costs. SEO is not one-size-fits-all. Rather, it encompasses a range of activities, each with its own cost implications.

- **Technical SEO:** Ensuring your website is fast, error-free, and crawlable can involve a deep audit and the implementation of complex fixes, which can be a significant investment, especially for large sites.
- **Content marketing** : Creating high-quality, SEO-friendly content to resonate with your audience is an ongoing and labour-intensive effort, with costs depending on the frequency and depth of content produced.
- **Link building:** Acquiring high-authority backlinks is necessary to improve your website’s domain authority, but it’s also one of the most challenging and expensive parts of SEO.

Each of these services can add layers of cost. The more comprehensive your SEO strategy, the higher your costs.

### Geographical Targeting

Your SEO costs will rise accordingly if your business targets multiple locations or operates in international markets.

Geographical targeting requires customised strategies and an SEO campaign for each location, including localised keyword research, region-specific content and local link-building efforts.

Managing an SEO strategy across multiple regions or countries requires significant additional resources to ensure every target market is effectively reached and engaged. For enterprises looking to dominate in multiple geographical areas, this can substantially increase overall SEO costs.

### Agency Experience and Expertise

Working with a reputable, experienced SEO agency is invaluable, but it does come at a price. Agencies with a proven track record, especially in handling complex enterprise-level projects, often charge more because they bring specialised knowledge, advanced tools, and a successful delivery history.

While opting for a lower-cost provider can be tempting, with SEO, you get what you paid for.

Investing in a skilled agency can mean the difference between campaigns that just tick the boxes and ones that drive substantial, measurable growth. The higher upfront cost can lead to a greater return on investment, making it a smart choice for companies looking for results.

## Common SEO Service Packages

Examples of SEO service packages that may be available include:

### Basic SEO Package

Basic packages are meant for businesses starting with SEO or those with a limited budget. Basic packages might include fundamental services like:

- Keyword research.
- On-page optimisation, including meta tags, headers and content for target keywords.
- Basic technical SEO addressing issues like site speed, mobile responsiveness, and crawl errors.
- Monthly reporting on keyword rankings and traffic.

A basic package may cover essential aspects of SEO but might need to be more for larger businesses with more complex needs or highly competitive industries.

### Comprehensive SEO Package

While they can vary in specifics, comprehensive packages are more robust and suited to businesses that want to significantly boost their online presence.

Along with the services you can expect with a basic-level package, comprehensive options might include:

- Content marketing including regular creation and optimisation of blog posts, articles and other content.
- Advanced technical SEO audit, including fixes like optimising site architecture and implementing structured data.
- Link building includes creating a strategy to acquire high-quality backlinks and improving domain authority.
- Local SEO to optimise for local search, including Google My Business management.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to improve the user experience and increase conversions.

These packages might meet the needs of businesses in competitive markets or those seeking to grow significantly through their digital channels.

### Enterprise SEO Package

These packages are tailored for large companies with complex needs and a focus on custom strategies. Additional features might include:

- A fully bespoke SEO plan designed to meet specific goals and challenges of an enterprise.
- A dedicated team of specialists working exclusively on your account, providing ongoing adjustments and support.
- Optimising your site for international SEO, including multiple languages and regions.
- Deep dive into competitor strategies to identify opportunities and threats.

These packages are best suited for companies that need a high-impact, tailored SEO strategy to maintain a competitive edge.

### Additional Services

Specialised services like local SEO and e-commerce SEO may be added to standard packages.

Technical audits, which are comprehensive reviews of your website’s technical health, are also available.

These additional services let businesses fine-tune SEO efforts and address specific needs.

## How to Determine the Right SEO Budget

To determine your SEO budget, keep a few considerations in mind.

### Assess Your Goals

The first step in determining your budget is aligning it with business objectives. Do you want to increase your brand visibility, drive traffic, or boost conversions?

Understanding specific goals will help you decide how much to invest in SEO.

For example, if you’re launching a new product and want to see quick results, you’ll need a more aggressive SEO strategy and a higher budget.

On the other hand, if your goal is steady growth over time, your budget could be moderate and focused on long-term results.

The key is matching your SEO spend with desired outcomes to ensure your investment directly supports your business goals.

### Calculating ROI

When determining your SEO budget, consider your return on investment.

Start by estimating the value of the additional traffic you expect to gain from improved search rankings. Compare this to the cost of your SEO investment.

Remember that SEO’s impact compounds over time, so your ROI could increase as your rankings improve and you see more traffic flowing in.

### Long-Term vs. Short-Term Investment

SEO is a long game, and your budget needs to be viewed as an investment in sustained growth instead of a quick fix.

While you might see some immediate improvements, the real benefits of SEO can take months to materialise.

While a short-term investment may yield temporary gains, you need to commit to SEO for the long haul for lasting impact.

Think about how much you will invest over the next 6-12 months and beyond.

Treating SEO as a long-term strategy helps you build a strong foundation, so your investment pays off over time.

## Common Pitfalls When Choosing an SEO Provider

Avoid these pitfalls when you’re budgeting for SEO and choosing a provider:

### Choosing Only Based on Price

One of the biggest mistakes when choosing an SEO provider is only considering price. Opting for cheap SEO services can mean they cut corners, use outdated or unethical practices, and even harm your site’s rankings.

Quality SEO requires time, expertise and resources. Investing in an experienced, reputable agency can cost more upfront but is more likely to deliver sustainable long-term results.

### Lack of Transparency

Transparency is crucial when you’re working with an SEO provider.

Without detailed deliverables, clear pricing, and regular updates, you could end up paying for unnecessary services or those that don’t deliver results.

A reputable SEO agency will clearly explain what you’re paying for and how it aligns with your goals. This includes regular progress reports, challenges and next steps.

If an agency is vague about processes or hesitant to share results, it’s a red flag.

Clear communication and transparency build trust, ensuring you get value from your investment.

### Over-Promising Results

Be wary of SEO agencies promising unrealistic outcomes or quick fixes. SEO is a complex and always-evolving field; no legitimate agency can control search engine algorithms.

Look for providers who set realistic expectations and emphasise a strategic, long-term approach.

A good agency will be upfront about challenges and timelines for achieving meaningful results.

## What’s the Next Step?

Understanding SEO pricing is crucial to making informed decisions that align with your business objectives. Recognising the factors influencing costs and choosing the right investment level ensures your SEO strategy drives meaningful, long-term results.

## YMYL SEO Optimization

Source: https://prosperitymedia.com.au/ymyl/

# YMYL: How To Optimize For SEO

Want some help with your YMYL SEO? Reach out to our experienced SEOs to find out more

If you’re working with a site that is in the YMYL category, then be prepared for the *strictest* guidelines possible.

This means that not only will you need the highest quality content, but several extra features to make your website trustworthy.

Having worked in SEO for more than a decade we’ve been around long enough to see this unfold.

Fortunately, this means we have a load of first-experience of working with and ranking YMYL websites.

To find out what we’ve learned then continue reading this post.

If you’re looking for some help with optimizing your YMYL website, then [contact](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/contact/) our experienced team to see what we could do for you.

## What is YMYL?

YMYL content refers to pages or topics that have the potential to significantly influence important aspects of someone’s life.

This includes information on:

- Health concerns
- Financial advice
- Legal matters
- News stories
- And similar industries

Essentially, any content that could potentially shape a person’s well-being falls under the YMYL category.

Google introduced the concept of YMYL content in its Search Quality Evaluator Guidelines ([SQEG](https://static.googleusercontent.com/media/guidelines.raterhub.com/en//searchqualityevaluatorguidelines.pdf)), which were designed to help improve its ranking algorithm and deliver more relevant search results.

As a result, optimizing your content for YMYL is crucial for search engine optimization (SEO).

It requires creating high-quality articles and sections that provide accurate and up-to-date information on topics within the YMYL realm.

By incorporating trustworthy sources, citing reputable studies or experts in the field, and ensuring that the information provided is reliable and valuable to users’ lives, you can optimize your content for better visibility in search engine rankings.

The way that search engines evaluate this is through E-E-A-T.

Matthew Barby, Senior Director of Acquisition at HubSpot

"Whenever I have companies ask me if there are any great agencies in Australia, I always point them to Prosperity Media. James and team are always pushing out incredibly impactful work, and their depth of knowledge around SEO and content marketing is up there with the best in the world."

## What is E-E-A-T?

Ensure that your website establishes trust and credibility by following the E-E-A-T principles: experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trustworthiness.

Google will asses all content, but particularly YMYL content, primarily against these principles.

Experience, expertise and authoritativeness all help to establish trust.

**Experience**

Google wants to know that you’re writing with some kind of experience; first-hand, professional, or life experience.

Wherever your experience is coming from it should result in unique content.

**Expertise**

Different topics require different levels of expertise in order to be classified as trustworthy.

This is the example in the SQEG.

Which would you trust: home electrical rewiring advice from a skilled electrician or from an antique homes enthusiast who has no knowledge of electrical wiring?


Matching the content to the expertise of the content creator is what Google is looking for here.

**Authority**

How reliable and trustworthy is your website for the topic that you’re discussing?

Google understands that not *every* website is going to be the definitive source for a topic. 

But, the more topical expertise and industry standing your site and content creators have, the more it will be seen as an authority.

This likely has at least some correlation to domain authority so it’s something that you can improve upon over time.

In our experience, acquiring backlinks and mentions from established, trusted sources can speed up this process.

**Trust**

This is what E-E-A-T comes down to; can your content and website be trusted?

By adhering to the expertise, experience and authority principles mentioned above, your website can build its trust in the eyes of Google.

Both the content matter and the content itself should be of the highest quality.

To create high-quality YMYL content, there are a few best practices that you need to follow.

## YMYL SEO Best Practices

While Google states that YMYL is not a direct ranking factor it does give an insight into what they class as ‘good’ content.

This means that you will want to optimize your content so that Google sees it as high-quality.

Even though they might not admit that it’s a ranking factor, you can be sure that they’re doing everything to avoid showing untrustworthy content.

These best practices should go hand in hand with your search engine optimization strategy to give you the best chance of ranking.

### Expert Content Writers and Reviewers

To get the best quality content possible you should have it written by relevant experts or professionals.

These experts possess the necessary expertise and knowledge to provide accurate and reliable information to your audience.

Not only does this help establish trust with your readers, but it also demonstrates to search engines like Google that you’re producing authoritative content.

If your team doesn’t have the time or resources to have an expert write the content, hire an experienced writer and use an expert to review it.

That way the expert can receive a finished article to add their experience and fact check.

With YMYL content it’s also important to display information *about* your content creators. 

Each page should have the details of the writer, expert and editor, where applicable, displayed in a bio.

The bio can highlight the experience and qualifications that the content writers have.

This level of transparency not only shows accountability for the production of the content but also establishes topic expertise.

### About Us & Contact Us Pages

These pages are crucial for establishing trust and credibility with your audience and algorithms.

They provide vital information about your brand and allow customers to reach out for assistance.

When visitors land on your website, they should easily find your About Us and Contact Us pages.

This will allow them to access your contact information and customer support options.

Make sure to include clear links to these pages in either your main navigation or footer.

This way, visitors can quickly locate them regardless of where they are on your site.

Optimizing your About Us page is essential for enhancing the E-E-A-T of your website.

Use this page to tell the story of your brand, highlighting key achievements, credentials, and values of your team and content creators.

The same can be done for the Contact Us page.

Ensure that all necessary contact details such as phone numbers, email addresses, and social media handles are prominently displayed.

Consider including a contact form or live chat option for convenience.

All of these are trust factors that establish the legitimacy of your business.

### High-Quality Backlinks

To truly establish your website as a trusted source in your industry, securing high-quality backlinks from reputable websites is vital.

These backlinks act as endorsements from other experts in the field, showing that your content is valuable and trustworthy.

When other websites are willing to cite you as a source and associate their brand with yours, it boosts the authority of your own site.

This has a two-fold benefit. It doesn’t just make your website seem more authoritative but it also helps your content to rank better.

When our agency works with a YMYL site, we’ll create a digital PR campaign to acquire high-quality links.

We’ll work with the brand to create a content marketing asset for their website. Something that their audience will find interesting or useful.

Our team handles the creation of the asset and will then start an outreach campaign to acquire the authoritative links.

This is one of the best methods to build links for YMYL sites.

As you can see above, this website in the medical niche **secured 46 links** from the campaign.

If you want some help with link-building digital PR, or with other YMYL SEO tactics like this, you can [send our team a message](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/contact/).

However, it’s important to remember that you should be selective in who you outreach.

While good-quality links can help your site, lots of low-quality or spammy links can harm it.

Continually manage your backlink profile to avoid this.

### Citations

Citations are external links to authoritative sites that provide additional information and support to your content.

These external links not only add value and context to your writing but also help search engines determine the reliability and relevance of your content.

This is especially important for any content that is providing advice or factual information.

By linking to reputable sources, you show readers and search engines that you’ve done thorough research on the topic at hand.

To optimize your content effectively, be sure to include citations from authoritative websites related to your industry or niche.

Look for well-established sources that have a strong reputation for providing accurate information and expertise in their respective fields.

Also, when selecting external links, consider the relevance of the information provided by those sources to ensure they contribute meaningfully to the topic you’re discussing.

By adding external links from reputable sources, you not only enhance the credibility of your own website but also provide valuable resources for readers seeking additional information.

### Schema Markup

Schema markup provides search engines with specific information about the content on your web pages.

This can help them to understand the context of your content and display it in a more appealing way on the search engine results pages (SERP).

One of the key benefits of using schema markup is that it helps Google identify important elements within your website, such as organisation details, site links search box, breadcrumb navigation, and frequently asked questions (FAQs).

This enhanced understanding not only improves Google’s ability to index and rank your web pages but also increases the chances of displaying rich search results that catch users’ attention.

By utilizing article schema in your content, you can unlock advanced features like carousels, visual stories, and richer result features on SERPs.

These visually appealing elements not only make your content stand out but also increase the likelihood of attracting clicks from potential users.

Implementing schema requires you to add code from [schema.org](https://schema.org/docs/schemas.html) to your website.

If you’re not comfortable with that, reach out to our team [here](https://prosperitymedia.com.au/contact/) and our SEOs can help you out.

### Regularly Updated Content

Content that’s not refreshed can quickly become outdated, losing its effectiveness and impact.

By regularly updating your content, you ensure that it remains aligned with current trends, industry best practices, and user expectations.

Regularly updated content also allows you to optimize your website for search engines.

It’s highly likely that search engines prioritise fresh, relevant content when determining search rankings.

By consistently refreshing your content, you signal to search engines that your website is actively maintained and provides valuable information to users.

This is particularly true for YMYL content where industries tend to change more rapidly than others.

A portion of your content marketing should be dedicated to reviewing old content.

Every three to six months you should have someone review old content to make sure that it’s still factually correct and up to date with the latest industry practices.

For evergreen, informational content this is less important.

But it’s a good idea to display the date the content was last reviewed even if no changes have been made.

## How to Write Good YMYL Content

Now that you know the main features of YMYL SEO content.

We’re going to share how we direct writers to write content that has consistently performed well in search engines for us and for our clients.

### Create Descriptive Page Titles

Your page title is often the first thing that users see in search engine results, so it needs to be compelling and informative.

A well-crafted descriptive page title not only entices users to click on your website but also helps search engines understand what your content is about.

By optimizing your content with relevant keywords in the page title, you can improve its visibility in search engine rankings.

To create an effective descriptive page title, start by understanding the intent of your target audience.

Conduct keyword research to identify the most relevant and popular terms related to your content.

Incorporate these keywords naturally into your page title, ensuring that it accurately describes what users can expect from clicking on your link.

Remember, search engines rely heavily on titles when determining the relevance of a webpage, so make sure yours stands out.

Optimizing your content with a descriptive page title plays a vital role in improving user engagement and boosting visibility on search engines.

Google’s SQEGs remind creators to not use page titles that are “extremely misleading, shocking, or exaggerated”.

The following examples of low-quality tiles are given:

### Get Straight to the Point

When users are searching for the answer to a question your content should provide the answer.

If a user clicks on your page and there are several paragraphs of ‘fluff’ content that provide no real answer, they’ll probably click away.

Not only is this losing you potential customers, but it’s sending signals to Google that your page doesn’t have the answer to that search query.

When you get straight to the point in your writing style, readers are more likely to engage and stay on your page longer.

Remember that YMYL topics require accuracy and reliability; therefore, being straightforward with factual data helps establish credibility.

### Provide Examples

By illustrating concepts through relatable stories or case studies, you not only engage your audience but also showcase the practical application of the information you’re sharing.

For example, if you’re writing about personal finance advice, instead of simply stating generic tips, you could provide specific examples of individuals who followed those tips and what happened.

This approach adds credibility to your content and allows readers to visualize how they can apply the advice to their own lives.

Google quality raters play an important role in evaluating websites based on their experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trustworthiness.

According to Google’s Quality Rater Guidelines, quality raters are instructed to look for concrete examples that support claims made on YMYL topics such as health, finance, or legal matters.

This can positively influence how search engine algorithms perceive your page’s quality and potentially boost its visibility in search results.

### Balanced Point of View

When it comes to optimizing your content for YMYL pages, one important aspect to consider is presenting a balanced point of view.

This means providing information from multiple sources and viewpoints, allowing your audience to make their own informed decisions.

To ensure a balanced point of view, it’s crucial to conduct thorough research and gather data from reputable sources.

Take into account various expert opinions and studies that contribute to the understanding of the topic.

Incorporating statistics, case studies, and real-life examples will further enhance the persuasiveness of your content.

By presenting both sides of an argument or different approaches to a problem, you enable your audience to weigh the pros and cons themselves.

This not only helps them make better-informed decisions but also establishes your page quality in the eyes of quality raters who assess the reliability and usefulness of web content.

Ensure that any claims made are backed by reliable sources and avoid promoting misinformation or biased views.

Strive for transparency by clearly stating any potential conflicts of interest or affiliations with brands mentioned in your content.

### Positive User Experience

A positive user experience is crucial for optimizing your content and ensuring that visitors stay on your page longer.

Provide a well-structured layout with clear navigation, such as utilising a table of contents for long pieces of content.

Allow users to easily find the information they’re looking for and jump to sections that are important to them.

This not only enhances their overall satisfaction but also increases the likelihood of them staying on your website.

Pop-ups that cover the main content and can’t be closed without taking an action that benefits the site will be classed as low-quality content.

Instead of bombarding users with intrusive advertisements, ads need to be placed in designated areas on the page that don’t interfere with the content.

This ensures that users can focus on consuming your valuable content without any distractions or annoyances.

## YMYL Examples

To illustrate some of the points that we’ve been talking about we’ll share some examples from Google’s SQEGs.

They go into detail on what makes these pages high or low-quality pages.

This can help you to understand the way in which websites are assessed.

### High-Quality Page

This is an example of a page that received a high-quality rating.

[Click here](https://guidelines.raterhub.com/images/aG8lyAcK95SZAynzPkWt.jpg) to see an image of the full page.

Although it’s not a YMYL page specifically, it satisfies Google’s expectations for content.

It does this by having “very satisfying” main content that achieves the purpose of the page very well.

If you take a look at the full page it answers the searcher’s question straight away.

Even though the page uses display ads they are kept below this so the page still receives the highest quality rating.

In their assessment, Google also pointed to the website having a very high reputation, E-E-A-T, and unique content.

This can be seen as the website is a well-known fact-checking and debunking website that covers urban legends, Internet rumours, and other stories of unknown or questionable origin.

The contents of this article are in keeping with the content of the whole website, this gives the article a higher rating because the site has built expertise in the niche.

### Low-Quality Page

[This article](https://guidelines.raterhub.com/images/uVoX1DYyAwxqYn9DsmAz.jpg) is a YMYL page because it relates to financial advice.

It’s seen as low-quality as it has low levels of E-E-A-T.

The amount of main content on the page is seen as superficial and doesn’t provide anything that isn’t commonly known about this subject.

However, the biggest factor for the low rating is that this is a YMYL topic and there’s no evidence of financial expertise.

This only further highlights the fact that you not only need to be using expert-created content for YMYL topics, but you also need to *display* that you are.
